glossary.definition: (C) "Claim" means a right to payment, whether or not the right is reduced to judgment, liquidated, unliquidated, fixed, contingent, matured, unmatured, disputed, undisputed, legal, equitable, secured, or unsecured.
glossary.source_title: Section 1336.01 - Ohio uniform fraudulent transfer act definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "Creditor" means a person who has a claim.
glossary.source_title: Section 1336.01 - Ohio uniform fraudulent transfer act definitions.
Section 1336.01 - Ohio uniform fraudulent transfer act definitions.

glossary.definition: (F) "Debtor" means a person who is liable on a claim.
glossary.source_title: Section 1336.01 - Ohio uniform fraudulent transfer act definitions.
Section 1336.01 - Ohio uniform fraudulent transfer act definitions.

glossary.definition: (H) "Lien" means a charge against or an interest in property to secure payment of a debt or performance of an obligation, and includes a security interest created by agreement, a judicial lien obtained by legal or equitable process or proceedings, a common law lien, or a statutory lien.
glossary.source_title: Section 1336.01 - Ohio uniform fraudulent transfer act definitions.

glossary.definition: (I) "Person" means an individual, partnership, corporation, association, organization, government or governmental subdivision or agency, business trust, estate, trust, or any other legal or commercial entity.
glossary.source_title: Section 1336.01 - Ohio uniform fraudulent transfer act definitions.

glossary.definition: (J) "Property" means anything that may be the subject of ownership.
glossary.source_title: Section 1336.01 - Ohio uniform fraudulent transfer act definitions.

glossary.definition: (K) "Relative" means an individual related by consanguinity within the third degree as determined by the common law, a spouse, or an individual related to a spouse within the third degree as so determined, and includes an individual in an adoptive relationship within the third degree.
glossary.source_title: Section 1336.01 - Ohio uniform fraudulent transfer act definitions.

glossary.definition: (L) "Transfer" means every direct or indirect, absolute or conditional, and voluntary or involuntary method of disposing of or parting with an asset or an interest in an asset, and includes payment of money, release, lease, and creation of a lien or other encumbrance.
glossary.source_title: Section 1336.01 - Ohio uniform fraudulent transfer act definitions.

glossary.definition: (M) "Valid lien" means a lien that is effective against the holder of a judicial lien subsequently obtained by legal or equitable process or proceedings.
glossary.source_title: Section 1336.01 - Ohio uniform fraudulent transfer act definitions.
